text:
kevin: hey team — pinging for a quick review. PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-deploys/pull/2784

kevin: this fixes the TLS chain and extra SANs for MarinerHealth's private VPC routing. customer is waiting on cert renewal window tomorrow morning (SLA). can someone take a look + approve if ok? would like to merge today and run a short smoke test. :pray:

luisa: taking a look now. main change is in `helm/mariner-templates/tls.yaml` right? do we also need ingress rule tweak?

kevin: yep — tls.yaml + an annotation on `service/mariner-gateway` to add `service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-backend-protocol: http`. small diff, rebase done on latest main.

sana: can you paste the `kubectl diff` output you used? want to sanity-check there are no unexpected service replacements.

kevin: pasted below:
```
$ kubectl diff -f deploy/marinerhealth/overlay/production
diff -u -N ...
+        annotations:
+          service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-backend-protocol: "http"
-        tls.crt: old-cert
+        tls.crt: updated-chain
```

andy: CI looks green except an intermittent e2e flake on ci/integration-aws, but build passed. @ci-bot can you re-run the integration job once? want a clean run before merge.

ci-bot: re-run queued: ci/integration-aws #426 — will update when complete

melissa: skimmed the helm change — looks fine. two minor nits (comments) but not blocking. approve if security gives OK. :+1:

security-bot: quick scan: cert chain ok, no S3 secrets exposed, IAM role unchanged. scan result: PASS

luisa: approved, left one inline about annotation formatting but not blocking. please ensure smoke test checks TLS chain and client certs.

kevin: thanks all. @andy / @sana can you do the smoke test in staging after merge? plan is to merge ~16:30 UTC if integration re-run is green and smoke passes.

andy: I can do a quick smoke at 16:40 UTC, ping me when merged.

sana: available for follow-up checks — will watch logs during rollout.

ci-bot: ci/integration-aws #426: SUCCESS — all checks passed

kevin: ok merging now. command used:
```
$ gh pr merge 2784 --merge --admin
```

kevin: merged and kicked the staging rollout. smoke test started: `scripts/smoke-mariner.sh --env=staging`

andy: smoke passed — TLS chain validated, SANs look correct. rolling to prod in the window tomorrow morning as planned.

melissa: thanks! recorded the change in the customer runbook and notified CSM.

kevin: closing the thread. :tada:
